answers.1: kubectl create job hello-job --image=busybox -n $NS -- echo hi
answers.2:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: batch-job
spec:
  completions: 3
  template:
    spec:
      restartPolicy: Never
      containers:
      - name: work
        image: busybox
        command: ["echo", "work"]
EOF
answers.3: kubectl create cronjob backup --image=busybox --schedule='*/5 * * * *' -n $NS -- echo backup
answers.5:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: node-agent
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: node-agent
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: node-agent
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: agent
        image: nginx
EOF
answers.7:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: probe-pod
spec:
  containers:
  - name: nginx
    image: nginx
    livenessProbe:
      httpGet:
        path: /
        port: 80
      initialDelaySeconds: 5
EOF

  name: ssd-pod

  nodeSelector:
    disktype: ssd

answers.9:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: init-pod
spec:
  volumes:
  - name: work
    emptyDir: {}
  initContainers:
  - name: prep
    image: busybox
    command: ["sh", "-c", "echo ready > /work/ready"]
    volumeMounts:
    - name: work
      mountPath: /work
  containers:
  - name: main
    image: nginx
    volumeMounts:
    - name: work
      mountPath: /work
EOF
answers.10:
kubectl apply -n $NS -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: env-pod
spec:
  containers:
  - name: nginx
    image: nginx
    env:
    - name: MY_POD
      valueFrom:
        fieldRef:
          fieldPath: metadata.name
EOF
